summary: Normalize qualified CLI agent IDs and support helper inherit-launcher bindings (Q411)

replay.detail: No historical agent subjects are renamed or rewritten.

schema.detail: Launcher bindings use existing extension storage; no schema migration is required.

rules.detail: Q411 helper inherit-launcher derives the launcher association from the authenticated agent session, not client-supplied ownership metadata.

compatibility.detail: agents new accepts team/worker and agent/team/worker as the same subject without doubling agent/. Short names retain host scoping, including when supplied with agent/. Agent lifecycle commands also normalize already-qualified subjects exactly once. Existing subjects are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime or live migration is required.

manual.detail: No manual migration is required. Use the created subject returned by the CLI for later commands.

recovery.detail: Helper inherit-launcher associations are bound to the launcher's runtime incarnation rather than treating a later launcher runtime as the same launch.
